label: Notion
description: Search, read, append to and create pages in the connected Notion workspace.

auth.guide:
Notion connects with a key you make yourself and paste once.

1. Open https://www.notion.so/my-integrations and create a new internal integration in your workspace.
2. Let it read content, update content and insert content.
3. Copy its secret and paste it here. It is sealed on this computer and never shown again.
4. In Notion, open each page Athena may use and add the integration under Connections. It sees nothing you have not shared with it.

Writing stays off until a twin needs it, and then only on the pages you allow.

To take it back: delete the integration at https://www.notion.so/my-integrations. Disconnect here destroys the sealed key.
